notes: Daily ChatGPT selection from the fresh 72-hour Google Trends YouTube Search run. 195 deduped candidates were reviewed across US, Canada and Taiwan. Of 12 planned Explore requests, 11 succeeded; Canada/semiconductor failed because the Explore interest-over-time chart did not render, not because of 429 rate limiting. Fresh RSS and the other successful Explore data were retained. Duplicate long-tail queries were merged; sports, entertainment, creator/channel names, generic how-to/evergreen queries and low-value noise were removed. Dynamic relevance_groups are intentionally recall-safe and are used only to determine whether returned YouTube titles are substantially about each selected entity/topic before metrics are calculated.
